fact_english: The fluffy fibre of the kapok tree was once widely used to fill life jackets, because it is light, floats well and resists water.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang bulak ng kapok, dati ipinanpupuno sa mga life jacket, kasi magaan, lumulutang, at hindi agad nababasa!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Unan na nagliligtas ng buhay. Gusto ko 'yan.

after_text: Mayo 1898, isang makitid na kalye, at isang bintanang may liwanag ng lampara.
why_here: After the lamplit window in 1898: who is inside comes next.
